title: AAPS thinks it's outdated even though latest version is installed - closed loop disabled
symptom: When using AAPS for over 30 days, even after updating to the latest version on either master or dev branch, closed loop will be disabled and IOB will be limited to 0.0. The logs report 'Version Checker: old version'.
cause: The version check function is called on app launch before any network event has occurred, so isConnected() returns false because lastNetworkEvent is null, causing the version check to be skipped and the app to think it is outdated.
fix: The issue was improved by a commit (b5823eeaa1a1044f71bdc90cc6f82107d0515461) that likely triggers the version check later or on network change, but the thread does not specify the exact fix.
evidence_quote: However, when this function is called on app launch, there is no network event yet, so this getter returns false.
